profile_text.body:
Zscaler is a publicly traded cloud security company, listed on Nasdaq under the ticker ZS (CIK 0001713683), that describes itself as a leading cloud enterprise security provider helping global businesses adopt zero trust for secure digital transformation. Its core offering is the Zero Trust Exchange platform, which the company says leverages what it calls the largest security cloud on the planet to help established enterprises secure and simplify their operations. The site also emphasizes a partner and integration ecosystem intended to support faster deployments and more agile cloud operations.

On the AI side, Zscaler offers a product tracked as Zscaler AI, positioned within the Security and Identity AI category. It encompasses cloud security AI capabilities, a security service edge platform, data loss prevention, and AI traffic inspection. The company's site notes that a unified, zero-trust framework for tracing data lineage and governing agent-to-agent interactions is central to maintaining compliance and competitive advantage as AI adoption grows.

The held facts confirm Zscaler is a for-profit public company with no litigation or MCP server entries currently on record at this site.
